operationsIssues.title: Parent pickup calls via loudspeaker (مكبر الصوت)
operationsIssues.titleAr: استدعاء التلاميذ عند حضور الأولياء عبر مكبر الصوت
operationsIssues.summary: When parents arrive to collect students, names are announced on the school loudspeaker (مكبر الصوت). Students leave their classrooms early and wait outside, disrupting lessons.
currentProcess: Parent arrives at reception / gate to take their child.
The student’s name is announced on the loudspeaker (مكبر الصوت).
Students often leave their classrooms up to about 30 minutes before the real pickup moment and gather outside waiting to be called.
Classes are interrupted repeatedly throughout the afternoon dismissal window.
impact: Lost instructional time — students exit rooms early.
Crowding in corridors and outside areas.
Noise and disruption for students who are still in class.
Harder supervision: many children out of class at once.
Broadcast announcements disturb the whole school for each individual pickup.
operationsIssues.goal: Keep students in their classrooms until they are specifically needed, and call them in a targeted way (by class code such as 4P10 / 1M1) instead of emptying rooms early via school-wide loudspeaker.
operationsIssues.notes: Staff are familiar with class codes (e.g. 4P10, 1M1). Any improved process should use those codes so the right room is contacted without a campus-wide announcement.
